answer_2.quote: For the SEO Writer task, we use an API called SEO Review Tools (SEO) to measure the quality of generated content... For the Image Generator task... we use OpenAI's Contrastive Language-Image Pretraining (CLIP) model to embed the prompt and the corresponding image and calculate the cosine similarity between the two embeddings.
